supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant lateral extension beyond the outer canthi of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; muzzle and chin regions exhibit significant depigmentation/lightening compared to the dark, melanin-rich periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip with a neutral downward droop

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, dense white/grey hair growth concentrated on the chin forming a distinct beard
